  <script>
    
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async function() {
  const loading = document.getElementById('__bundler_loading');
  function setStatus(msg) { if (loading) loading.textContent = msg; }

  const FONT_MIME = /^(font[/]|application[/](x-)?font-|application[/]vnd\.ms-fontobject)/i;
  const MIME_TOKEN = /^[\w.+-]+[/][\w.+-]+$/;
  function toBase64(bytes) {
    let bin = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000) {
      bin += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
    }
    return btoa(bin);
  }

  // Error sink persists across replaceWith since it's on window, not the DOM.
  window.addEventListener('error', function(e) {
    // Failed resource loads (CSP-blocked links, scripts, images) fire plain
    // events at the element — warn only; real JS errors carry message/error.
    if (!e.message && !e.error && e.target && e.target !== window) {
      console.warn('[bundle] resource failed to load:',
        e.target.tagName, String(e.target.src || e.target.href || ''));
      return;
    }
    var p = document.body || document.documentElement;
    var d = document.getElementById('__bundler_err') || p.appendChild(document.createElement('div'));
    d.id = '__bundler_err';
    d.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:12px;left:12px;right:12px;font:12px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace;background:#2a1215;color:#ff8a80;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #5c2b2e;z-index:99999;white-space:pre-wrap;max-height:40vh;overflow:auto';
    d.textContent = (d.textContent ? d.textContent + String.fromCharCode(10) : '') +
      '[bundle] ' + (e.message || e.type) +
      (e.filename ? ' (' + e.filename.slice(0, 60) + ':' + e.lineno + ')' : '');
  }, true);

  try {
    const manifestEl = document.querySelector('script[type="__bundler/manifest"]');
    const templateEl = document.querySelector('script[type="__bundler/template"]');
    if (!manifestEl || !templateEl) {
      setStatus('Error: missing bundle data');
      console.error('[bundler] Missing script tags — manifestEl:', !!manifestEl, 'templateEl:', !!templateEl);
      return;
    }

    const manifest = JSON.parse(manifestEl.textContent);
    let template = JSON.parse(templateEl.textContent);

    // Nested page bundles (iframe targets). Each ships ONCE, in the ROOT
    // document's manifest; frame srcs carry an about:blank#<uuid> marker
    // instead of a substitutable uuid. Every document mints the blobs for
    // its OWN frames — from local text at the root, or text obtained from
    // its DIRECT parent over the relay protocol below — so each frame
    // navigation stays same-origin with its initiator and a deduped page
    // loads at any depth on any host, including a file:// download's
    // opaque origins (where a blob minted by one document cannot be
    // navigated to by another).
    const pageOrderEl = document.querySelector('script[type="__bundler/page_order"]');
    const pageOrder = pageOrderEl ? JSON.parse(pageOrderEl.textContent) : [];
    const pageSet = new Set(pageOrder);
    const pageTexts = {};

    // ── Nested-page text protocol (parent-chain relay) ──
    // Page bundles ship once, in the ROOT document's manifest. Every
    // document mints the blobs for its OWN frames, obtaining page text
    // through a strict parent-chain relay: a document only ever SENDS to
    // its direct parent (which, for every document the publisher's own
    // runtime minted, is another publisher document) and only ACCEPTS
    // text from that direct parent; requests from below are honored only
    // for the document's own child frames, and the ROOT never sends
    // upward at all. That last rule is load-bearing: the artifact host's
    // frame-ancestors allows claude.ai (and friends) to frame an
    // artifact, so window.top can be a FOREIGN document — a top-addressed
    // protocol would hand page uuids to that ancestor and accept forged
    // "page text" from it, minting attacker HTML as an artifact-origin
    // blob document. The chain never touches the ancestor: requests stop
    // at the root, replies are origin-addressed per hop (never '*' when
    // an origin exists), and both directions are origin-gated (on https
    // a foreign sender's origin can never equal this document's; in
    // opaque contexts — file:// — everything serializes as 'null', where
    // an embedded EXTERNAL frame still fails the gate by carrying its
    // own real origin, and a sandboxed child of such a frame is excluded
    // by the own-child-frames check plus uuid unguessability). Shape is
    // deny-by-default: one request form, one reply form, no error
    // replies.
    // window.origin is the SERIALIZED SECURITY origin ('null' in opaque
    // contexts such as a sandboxed preview iframe) — location.origin is
    // computed from the URL and stays 'https://…' even when the document
    // is sandboxed, which would misgate every opaque chain.
    const OWN_TARGET = /^https?:[/][/]/.test(window.origin || '')
      ? window.origin
      : '*';
    function trustedOrigin(e) {
      if (e.origin === window.origin) return true; // https chains; opaque==opaque
      // file:// trees: Chrome serializes the file document's origin as
      // 'file://' while the blob: documents it mints serialize as 'null',
      // so the two legitimate shapes can never string-match — accept the
      // pair in both directions. https origins never serialize as either,
      // and sender identity (own child frame / direct parent) is checked
      // separately.
      return (
        (e.origin === 'null' &&
          (window.origin === 'file://' ||
            window.location.protocol === 'file:')) ||
        (/^file:/.test(e.origin) && window.origin === 'null')
      );
    }
    // Non-empty only in the root document (nested bundles ship an empty
    // island), so it doubles as the root marker: the root answers from
    // local text and treats a miss as authoritative — never relaying to
    // its (possibly foreign) parent.
    const isPageRoot = pageOrder.length > 0;
    const blobUrls = {};
    const resourceBlobs = {};
    const UUID_SHAPE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;
    const pendingFrames = {}; // uuid -> [{el, frag}] awaiting text for own frames
    const pendingRelays = {}; // uuid -> [childWindow] awaiting text to pass down
    function mountPage(el, frag, text) {
      const pageBlob = new Blob([text], { type: 'text/html' });
      const u = URL.createObjectURL(pageBlob);
      resourceBlobs[u] = pageBlob;
      el.src = u + frag;
    }
    function deliverPage(uuid, text) {
      const frames = pendingFrames[uuid];
      delete pendingFrames[uuid];
      if (frames) for (const f of frames) mountPage(f.el, f.frag, text);
      const relays = pendingRelays[uuid];
      delete pendingRelays[uuid];
      if (relays) {
        for (const cw of relays) {
          try { cw.postMessage({ __bundler_page: uuid, __bundler_text: text }, OWN_TARGET); } catch (err) { /* gone */ }
        }
      }
    }
    function ownFrameWindows() {
      const out = [];
      for (const f of Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('iframe'))) {
        try { if (f.contentWindow) out.push(f.contentWindow); } catch (err) { /* detached */ }
      }
      return out;
    }
    window.addEventListener('message', function (e) {
      const d = e.data;
      if (!d || typeof d !== 'object' || !e.source) return;
      // Origin gate first; the structural checks below (own-child-frames
      // for requests, direct-parent + solicited-uuid for replies, the
      // root's never-relay rule) are what hold in fully opaque chains
      // where origin strings can't discriminate — a sandboxed root's
      // FOREIGN wrapper still fails all three even though both serialize
      // as real-vs-'null' rather than matching.
      if (!trustedOrigin(e)) return;
      if (typeof d.__bundler_need === 'string' && UUID_SHAPE.test(d.__bundler_need)) {
        // Requests are honored only for this document's own child frames.
        if (ownFrameWindows().indexOf(e.source) < 0) return;
        const uuid = d.__bundler_need;
        const text = pageTexts[uuid];
        if (typeof text === 'string') {
          try { e.source.postMessage({ __bundler_page: uuid, __bundler_text: text }, OWN_TARGET); } catch (err) { /* gone */ }
          return;
        }
        if (isPageRoot || window.parent === window) return; // authoritative miss
        const waiting = pendingRelays[uuid];
        if (waiting) {
          if (waiting.indexOf(e.source) < 0) waiting.push(e.source);
          return;
        }
        // Never-answered uuids would otherwise accumulate forever under a
        // request spray; past the cap (far above any real page count) new
        // relays are dropped rather than remembered.
        if (Object.keys(pendingRelays).length >= 128) return;
        pendingRelays[uuid] = [e.source];

      } else if (
        typeof d.__bundler_page === 'string' &&
        UUID_SHAPE.test(d.__bundler_page) &&
        typeof d.__bundler_text === 'string'

        // check below uses the in operator, which matches prototype keys
        // ('__proto__', 'constructor') — an unshaped key would reach
        // deliverPage and throw, painting the error banner.
        // Text is accepted only from the direct parent — the document
        // that minted this one.

        if (!(d.__bundler_page in pendingFrames) && !(d.__bundler_page in pendingRelays)) return;
        deliverPage(d.__bundler_page, d.__bundler_text);
      }
    });

    const uuids = Object.keys(manifest);
    setStatus('Unpacking ' + uuids.length + ' assets...');

    await Promise.all(uuids.map(async (uuid) => {
      const entry = manifest[uuid];
      try {
        const binaryStr = atob(entry.data);
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(binaryStr.length);
        for (let i = 0; i < binaryStr.length; i++) bytes[i] = binaryStr.charCodeAt(i);

        let finalBytes = bytes;

            const ds = new DecompressionStream('gzip');
            const writer = ds.writable.getWriter();
            const reader = ds.readable.getReader();
            writer.write(bytes);

            for (const chunk of chunks) { finalBytes.set(chunk, offset); offset += chunk.length; }

          return;

    const extResources = extResEl ? JSON.parse(extResEl.textContent) : [];

    // consumers read these Blobs directly. Survives the swap like the error sink.

    // Page uuids have no blob here — they ride inside about:blank#<uuid>
    // frame markers the pass below resolves after the swap.
    for (const uuid of uuids) {

    // a null origin, so crossorigin forces a CORS fetch that SRI then rejects.
    // The manifest bytes are ours; SRI protects against CDN compromise, not this.

      JSON.stringify(resourceMap).replace(/<\//g, '<\\/') +
      ';</' + 'script>';

    // would push the parser into quirks mode. DOMParser always emits a <head>
    // (synthesizing one if the source HTML omitted it) but may carry
    // attributes through, so match the full opening tag. slice() rather than
    // replace() keeps us clear of $-pattern substitution in resourceScript.

      const i = headOpen.index + headOpen[0].length;
      template = template.slice(0, i) + resourceScript + template.slice(i);
    }

    // DOMParser/replaceWith are inert per spec — re-create each with
    // createElement so they execute, awaiting onload for src scripts to
    // preserve ordering (React before ReactDOM before Babel before text/babel).
    const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(template, 'text/html');
    document.documentElement.replaceWith(doc.documentElement);

    // Resolve page-frame markers: mint this document's own blob for each
    // framed page — from local text when this is the root, otherwise by
    // asking the direct parent over the relay protocol above. An
    // unanswered request leaves the frame on about:blank, the same
    // degraded state as a refused embed.
    {
      const MARKER = /^about:blank#([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})(#.*)?$/;
      const needed = [];
      for (const el of Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('iframe'))) {
        const m = MARKER.exec(el.getAttribute('src') || '');
        if (!m) continue;
        const text = pageTexts[m[1]];
        if (typeof text === 'string') {
          mountPage(el, m[2] || '', text);
        } else if (window.parent !== window && !isPageRoot) {
          const had = pendingFrames[m[1]];
          (pendingFrames[m[1]] = had || []).push({ el: el, frag: m[2] || '' });
          if (!had) needed.push(m[1]);
        }
      }
      for (const uuid of needed) {
        window.parent.postMessage({ __bundler_need: uuid }, OWN_TARGET);
      }
    }

    const dead = Array.from(document.scripts);
    for (const old of dead) {
      const s = document.createElement('script');
      for (const a of old.attributes) s.setAttribute(a.name, a.value);
      s.textContent = old.textContent;
      // text/babel scripts with a src: read and inline. transformScriptTags
      // does XHR against the src, but blob:null/ from a file:// origin is
      // silently dropped. Inlining makes it a plain inline babel script,
      // which transformScriptTags handles unconditionally.
      if ((s.type === 'text/babel' || s.type === 'text/jsx') && s.src) {
        const pre = resourceBlobs[s.src.split('#')[0]];
        s.textContent = pre ? await pre.text() : await (await fetch(s.src)).text();
        s.removeAttribute('src');
      }
      const p = s.src ? new Promise(function(r) { s.onload = s.onerror = r; }) : null;
      old.replaceWith(s);
      if (p) await p;
    }
    // Babel standalone auto-transforms type=text/babel on DOMContentLoaded,
    // which fired before we swapped the document. Trigger manually if present.
    if (window.Babel && typeof window.Babel.transformScriptTags === 'function') {
      window.Babel.transformScriptTags();
    }
  } catch (err) {
    setStatus('Error unpacking: ' + err.message);
    console.error('Bundle unpack error:', err);
  }
});

Helvetica, sans-serif;\n  --font-accent: \"Caveat\", \"Segoe Script\", cursive;\n  --font-mono: ui-monospace, \"SFMono-Regular\", Menlo, monospace;\n}\n\n/* COLOR — por rol, nunca por valor.\n   REGLA DURA: el sistema arranca en escala de grises neutra.\n   No hay paleta cromatica por defecto: la rampa --accent-1..6 son grises\n   hasta que el usuario cargue una rampa (mono / analoga / manual).\n   Ningun componente escribe un color literal: todo sale de estas variables. */\n\n:root {\n  /* Neutros base — unica fuente de gris del sistema */\n  --n-0: #ffffff;\n  --n-25: #fbfbfa;\n  --n-50: #f5f5f4;\n  --n-100: #ebebe9;\n  --n-200: #dcdcd9;\n  --n-300: #c2c2be;\n  --n-400: #9c9c98;\n  --n-500: #787874;\n  --n-600: #5a5a57;\n  --n-700: #3f3f3d;\n  --n-800: #262625;\n  --n-900: #141413;\n\n  /* Roles semanticos */\n  --surface: var(--n-25);\n  --surface-alt: var(--n-0);\n  --surface-sunken: var(--n-50);\n  --ink: var(--n-900);\n  --ink-muted: var(--n-500);\n  --ink-inverse: var(--n-0);\n  --line: var(--n-200);\n  --line-strong: var(--n-400);\n  --placeholder: var(--n-300);\n\n  /* Rampa cromatica: 6 pasos, claro -> oscuro. Grises por defecto. */\n  --accent-1: var(--n-50);\n  --accent-2: var(--n-100);\n  --accent-3: var(--n-200);\n  --accent-4: var(--n-400);\n  --accent-5: var(--n-600);\n  --accent-6: var(--n-800);\n\n  /* Texto seguro sobre cada paso (>= 4.5:1). Pasos 1-4 son claros, 5-6 oscuros. */\n  --on-accent-1: var(--ink);\n  --on-accent-2: var(--ink);\n  --on-accent-3: var(--ink);\n  --on-accent-4: var(--n-900);\n  --on-accent-5: var(--ink-inverse);\n  --on-accent-6: var(--ink-inverse);\n\n  /* Estado */\n  --highlight: var(--n-100);       /* dia actual, fila activa */\n  --highlight-ink: var(--ink);\n  --focus-ring: var(--n-600);\n}\n\n/* Modo oscuro: recalcula roles, no invierte ciegamente.\n   Las superficies suben de valor, la rampa se reordena para que\n   los pasos claros sigan siendo fondos legibles. */\n:root[data-theme=\"dark\"] {\n  --surface: var(--n-900);\n  --surface-alt: #1c1c1b;\n  --surface-sunken: #101010;\n  --ink: var(--n-50);\n  --ink-muted: var(--n-400);\n  --ink-inverse: var(--n-900);\n  --line: #353533;\n  --line-strong: var(--n-600);\n  --placeholder: #3a3a38;\n\n  --accent-1: #232322;\n  --accent-2: #2e2e2c;\n  --accent-3: #3d3d3a;\n  --accent-4: var(--n-500);\n  --accent-5: var(--n-300);\n  --accent-6: var(--n-100);\n\n  --on-accent-1: var(--ink);\n  --on-accent-2: var(--ink);\n  --on-accent-3: var(--ink);\n  --on-accent-4: var(--n-900);\n  --on-accent-5: var(--n-900);\n  --on-accent-6: var(--n-900);\n\n  --highlight: #33332f;\n  --highlight-ink: var(--ink);\n  --focus-ring: var(--n-300);\n}\n\n/* NOMBRES DE RAMPA — editables por el usuario.\n   Se exponen como strings para poder imprimirlos con content: var(--accent-N-name).\n   Los nombres por defecto son neutros porque el sistema arranca en gris;\n   la referencia de nomenclatura del brief (\"Whipped Cream\", \"Latte Foam\",\n   \"Chai Mousse\", \"Iced Espresso\", \"Espresso Shot\", \"Bold Brew\") se aplica\n   al cargar una rampa cromatica. */\n:root {\n  --accent-1-name: \"Paper\"; /* @kind other */\n  --accent-2-name: \"Ash\"; /* @kind other */\n  --accent-3-name: \"Pencil\"; /* @kind other */\n  --accent-4-name: \"Graphite\"; /* @kind other */\n  --accent-5-name: \"Slate\"; /* @kind other */\n  --accent-6-name: \"Ink\"; /* @kind other */\n}\n\n/* TIPOGRAFIA — escala modular razon 1.25, multiplicada por --type-scale (0.85–1.3). */\n:root {\n  --type-scale: 1;\n\n  --fs-xs: calc(11px * var(--type-scale));    /* habit tracker, badges */\n  --fs-sm: calc(13px * var(--type-scale));    /* etiquetas, encabezados de dia */\n  --fs-base: calc(15px * var(--type-scale));  /* cuerpo, tareas */\n  --fs-lg: calc(20px * var(--type-scale));    /* titulos de bloque */\n  --fs-xl: calc(32px * var(--type-scale));    /* subtitulo */\n  --fs-2xl: calc(64px * var(--type-scale));   /* nombre del mes */\n\n  --lh-tight: 1.02; /* @kind other */\n  --lh-snug: 1.2; /* @kind other */\n  --lh-body: 1.5; /* @kind other */\n\n  --fw-light: 300; /* @kind font */\n  --fw-regular: 400; /* @kind font */\n  --fw-medium: 500; /* @kind font */\n  --fw-bold: 700; /* @kind font */\n  --fw-black: 900; /* @kind font */\n\n  /* Tracking critico */\n  --tr-weekday: 0.18em; /* @kind font */   /* LUN MAR MIE… mayusculas */\n  --tr-display-h: 0.12em; /* @kind font */ /* titulo display horizontal, mayusculas */\n  --tr-display-v: 0.02em; /* @kind font */ /* titulo display vertical rotado */\n  --tr-label: 0.08em; /* @kind font */     /* etiquetas de seccion */\n  --tr-normal: 0; /* @kind font */\n}\n\n/* GEOMETRIA — base de 4px. Impreso por defecto: radios en 0. */\n:root {\n  --radius-none: 0px;   /* rejilla editorial */\n  --radius-sm: 6px;     /* chips, badges */\n  --radius-md: 12px;    /* tarjetas de widget */\n  --radius-lg: 24px;    /* contenedores de paleta */\n\n  --stroke: 0.75px; /* @kind spacing */     /* hairline de rejilla */\n  --stroke-strong: 1.5px; /* @kind spacing */\n\n  --gap-grid: 0px;      /* rejilla continua */\n  --gap-block: 24px;    /* separacion entre modulos */\n\n  --space-1: 4px;\n  --space-2: 8px;\n  --space-3: 12px;\n  --space-4: 16px;\n  --space-5: 24px;\n  --space-6: 32px;\n  --space-7: 48px;\n  --space-8: 64px;\n\n  --margin-print: 48px; /* plantillas A y B */\n  --margin-screen: 24px;/* plantillas C y D */\n\n  /* Sombra: casi imperceptible, solo en widgets de pantalla */\n  --shadow-none: none;\n  --shadow-widget: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04), 0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.03);\n  --shadow-lift: 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06), 0 12px 32px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05);\n\n  /* Movimiento: transiciones cortas, sin rebote */\n  --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1); /* @kind other */\n  --dur-fast: 120ms; /* @kind other */\n  --dur-base: 180ms; /* @kind other */\n}\n\n/* ESTRUCTURA — tokens que el panel de control conmuta en vivo. */\n:root {\n  --cell-h: 96px;          /* densidad: compacta 72 / comoda 96 / amplia 128 */\n  --cell-pad: 6px;\n  --daynum-align: left; /* @kind other */    /* left | center */\n  --habit-cell: 20px;\n  --hour-row-h: 48px;\n  --week-label-w: 64px;\n  --chip-h: 18px;\n  --chips-max: 3; /* @kind other */\n  --grid-border-x: var(--stroke); /* rejilla completa vs solo horizontales (0) */\n  --grid-border-y: var(--stroke);\n}\n:root[data-density=\"compact\"] { --cell-h: 72px; --cell-pad: 4px; --hour-row-h: 40px; }\n:root[data-density=\"comfortable\"] { --cell-h: 96px; --cell-pad: 6px; --hour-row-h: 48px; }\n:root[data-density=\"roomy\"] { --cell-h: 128px; --cell-pad: 10px; --hour-row-h: 64px; }\n:root[data-borders=\"horizontal\"] { --grid-border-x: 0px; }\n:root[data-borders=\"none\"] { --grid-border-x: 0px; --grid-border-y: 0px; }\n\n/* SEMINARIO II 2026 — roles de color de revisión.\n   Entrada de color del usuario (referencias Pantone TCX).\n   No sobreescriben la rampa neutra del sistema: son roles nuevos. */\n:root {\n  --review-mon: #5a7692;        /* Pantone 18-3922 TCX Coronet Blue — lunes */\n  --review-mon-soft: #dde4ec;\n  --review-wed: #8fbd98;        /* Pantone 14-6319 TCX Meadow — miércoles */\n  --review-wed-soft: #e3efe6;\n  --review-virtual: #cdb380;    /* Pantone 14-1025 TCX Cocoon — revisión virtual */\n  --review-virtual-soft: #f4ecdc;\n  --on-review-mon: #ffffff;\n  --on-review-wed: #14251a;\n  --on-review-virtual: #3c2f16;\n  --mark-friday: #e8b921; tipograficos. */\n*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }\nbody {\n  margin: 0;\n  background: var(--surface);\n  color: var(--ink);\n  font-family: var(--font-ui);\n  font-size: var(--fs-base);\n  line-height: var(--lh-body);\n  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;\n  text-wrap: pretty;\n}\na { color: var(--accent-6); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: var(--stroke) solid var(--line-strong); transition: color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-standard); }\na:hover { color: var(--accent-5); border-bottom-color: var(--accent-5); }\n:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--font-ui);letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase\">{{ w.label }}<\u002Fspan>\n<span style=\"font:400 13px/1.3 var(--font-ui);color:var(--ink-muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums\">{{ w.range }}<\u002Fspan><span style=\"font:400 15px/1.4 var(--font-ui);text-wrap:pretty\">{{ w.activity }}<\u002Fspan>\n\n<\u002Fli>\n<\u002Fsc-for>\n<\u002Fol>\n<\u002Fsection>\n<\u002Fdiv>\n\n<aside data-layout=\"aside\">\n<div style=\"display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px\">\n\n<div style=\"display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px\">\n<button data-person=\"wed\" data-active=\"{{ }}\"><img src=\"b68c2417-eed4-4b8c-a584-8145815fc42b\" alt=\"Choeronycteris mexicana\" style=\"width:84px;height:84px;object-fit:contain;display:block\"><span style=\"font:600 16px/1 var(--font-ui);letter-spacing:0.06em\">Luis<\u002Fspan><\u002Fbutton>\n<\u002Fdiv>\n<button data-clear=\"1\" data-active=\"{{ clearActive }}\" sc-camel-on-click=\"{{ clearFilter }}\">Ver ambos<\u002Fbutton>\n<\u002Fdiv>\n\n<div style=\"background:var(--surface-alt);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px\">\n<div style=\"display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px\"><span style=\"font:500 12px/1 var(--font-ui);letter-spacing:0.18em;text-transform:uppercase\">{{ listTitle }}<\u002Fspan><span style=\"font:400 11px/1 var(--font-ui);color:var(--ink-muted)\">{{ listCount }}<\u002Fspan><\u002Fdiv>\n<ul style=\"list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column\">\n<sc-for list=\"{{ agenda }}\" as=\"a\" hint-placeholder-count=\"6\">\n<li style=\"display:flex;gap:11px;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)\">\n<span data-chip=\"{{ a.kind }}\">{{ a.chip }}<\u002Fspan>\n<span style=\"display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:0\">\n<span style=\"font:500 14px/1.3 var(--font-ui)\">{{ a.theme }}<\u002Fspan>\n<span style=\"font:400 12px/1.3 var(--font-ui);color:var(--ink-muted)\">{{ a.meta }}<\u002Fspan>\n<\u002Fspan>\n<\u002Fli>\n<\u002Fsc-for>\n<\u002Ful>\n<\u002Fdiv>\n<\u002Faside>\n\n<\u002Fdiv>\n<\u002Fdiv>\n<\u002Fdiv>\n\n<\u002Fx-dc>\n<script type=\"text/x-dc\" data-dc-script=\"\" data-props=\"{&quot;$preview&quot;:{&quot;width&quot;:1420,&quot;height&quot;:1000},&quot;numberFormat&quot;:{&quot;editor&quot;:&quot;enum&quot;,&quot;options&quot;:[&quot;1&quot;,&quot;01&quot;],&quot;default&quot;:&quot;1&quot;,&quot;tsType&quot;:&quot;string&quot;,&quot;section&quot;:&quot;Estructura&quot;}}\">\nconst MONTHS = [\n  { y: 2026, m: 8, name: \"Septiembre\" },\n  { y: 2026, m: 9, name: \"Octubre\" },\n  { y: 2026, m: 10, name: \"Noviembre\" },\n];\nconst SHORT = { 8: \"sep\", 9: \"oct\", 10: \"nov\", 11: \"dic\" };\n\n/* 12 semanas del periodo 7 sep – 27 nov 2026. Cada una arranca en lunes. */\nconst WEEKS = [\n  { n: 1, mon: [2026, 8, 7], activity: \"Primeras sesiones del seminario: encuadre y calendario de trabajo.\" },\n  { n: 2, mon: [2026, 8, 14], activity: \"Preparación de Antecedentes.\" },\n  { n: 3, mon: [2026, 8, 21], activity: \"Revisión de Antecedentes.\" },\n  { n: 4, mon: [2026, 8, 28], activity: \"Correcciones de Antecedentes - preparación de objetivos, hipótesis y justificación.\" },\n  { n: 5, mon: [2026, 9, 5], activity: \"Revisión de Objetivos, hipótesis y justificación.\" },\n  { n: 6, mon: [2026, 9, 12], activity: \"Correcciones de objetivos, hipótesis y justificación - preparación de materiales y métodos.\" },\n  { n: 7, mon: [2026, 9, 19], activity: \"Revisión de Materiales y métodos.\" },\n  { n: 8, mon: [2026, 9, 26], activity: \"Correcciones materiales y métodos - redacción de resultados preliminares.\" },\n  { n: 9, mon: [2026, 10, 2], activity: \"Revisión de Resultados preliminares.\" },\n  { n: 10, mon: [2026, 10, 9], activity: \"Correcciones de resultados - reconstrucción de la introducción.\" },\n  { n: 11, mon: [2026, 10, 16], activity: \"Revisión de Introducción y documento en general.\" },\n  { n: 12, mon: [2026, 10, 23], noAuto: true, activity: \"Revisión final para entrega al sínodo - entrega ideal el viernes 27.\" },\n  { n: 13, mon: [2026, 10, 30], noAuto: true, rangeLabel: \"30 nov\", activity: \"Fecha de entrega del documento: lunes 30 de noviembre.\" },\n];\n\n/* Marcas puntuales sobre el calendario, además de las revisiones. */\nconst MARKS = [\n  { d: [2026, 10, 23], type: \"final\", label: \"Revisión final para entrega al sínodo\" },\n  { d: [2026, 10, 24], type: \"final\", label: \"Revisión final para entrega al sínodo\" },\n  { d: [2026, 10, 25], type: \"final\", label: \"Revisión final para entrega al sínodo\" },\n  { d: [2026, 10, 26], type: \"final\", label: \"Revisión final para entrega al sínodo\" },\n  { d: [2026, 10, 27], type: \"entrega-ideal\", label: \"Entrega ideal\", note: \"Revisión final para entrega al sínodo\" },\n  { d: [2026, 10, 30], type: \"entrega\", label: \"Fecha de entrega\" },\n];\n\nconst REVIEWS = [\n  { d: [2026, 8, 7], kind: \"mon\", theme: \"Primera sesión\", week: 1 },\n  { d: [2026, 8, 9], kind: \"wed\", theme: \"Primera sesión\", week: 1 },\n  { d: [2026, 8, 21], kind: \"mon\", theme: \"Antecedentes\", week: 3 },\n  { d: [2026, 8, 23], kind: \"wed\", theme: \"Antecedentes\", week: 3 },\n  { d: [2026, 9, 5], kind: \"mon\", theme: \"Objetivos, hipótesis y justificación\", week: 5 },\n  { d: [2026, 9, 7], kind: \"wed\", theme: \"Objetivos, hipótesis y justificación\", week: 5 },\n  { d: [2026, 9, 19], kind: \"mon\", theme: \"Materiales y métodos\", week: 7 },\n  { d: [2026, 9, 21], kind: \"wed\", theme: \"Materiales y métodos\", week: 7 },\n  { d: [2026, 10, 2], kind: \"mon\", theme: \"Resultados preliminares\", week: 9 },\n  { d: [2026, 10, 4], kind: \"wed\", theme: \"Resultados preliminares\", week: 9 },\n  { d: [2026, 10, 16], kind: \"mon\", theme: \"Introducción y documento en general\", week: 11 },\n  { d: [2026, 10, 18], kind: \"wed\", theme: \"Introducción y documento en general\", week: 11 },\n];\n\nconst deJust = (s) => (s || \"\")\n  .split(\"Objetivos, hipótesis y justificación\").join(\"Objetivos e hipótesis\")\n  .split(\"objetivos, hipótesis y justificación\").join(\"objetivos e hipótesis\")\n  .split(\" y justificación\").join(\"\");\n\nconst key = (y, m, d) => y + \"-\" + m + \"-\" + d;\nconst monIdx = (dt) => (dt.getDay() + 6) % 7;\nconst flag = (b) => (b ? \"1\" : null);\n\nclass Component extends DCLogic {\n  state = { monthIdx: 0, filter: \"all\" };\n\n  setFilter = (f) => this.setState((s) => ({ filter: s.filter === f ? \"all\" : f }));\n\n  renderVals() {\n    const { monthIdx, filter } = this.state;\n    const M = MONTHS[monthIdx];\n    const pad = this.props.numberFormat === \"01\";\n    const fmt = (n) => (pad ? String(n).padStart(2, \"0\") : String(n));\n\n    const rev = {};\n    REVIEWS.forEach((r) => { rev[key(r.d[0], r.d[1], r.d[2])] = r; });\n    const weekByMonday = {};\n    WEEKS.forEach((w) => { weekByMonday[key(w.mon[0], w.mon[1], w.mon[2])] = w; });\n\n    /* Marcas: las explícitas más un viernes de revisión virtual en cada semana sin revisión. */\n    const marks = {};\n    MARKS.forEach((m) => { marks[key(m.d[0], m.d[1], m.d[2])] = m; });\n    const weeksWithReview = {};\n    REVIEWS.forEach((r) => { weeksWithReview[r.week] = true; });\n    WEEKS.forEach((w) => {\n      if (weeksWithReview[w.n] || w.noAuto) return;\n      const f = new Date(w.mon[0], w.mon[1], w.mon[2] + 4);\n      const fk = key(f.getFullYear(), f.getMonth(), f.getDate());\n      if (!marks[fk]) marks[fk] = { type: \"virtual\", label: \"Revisión virtual\" };\n    });\n\n    const monthTabs = MONTHS.map((mm, i) => ({\n      name: mm.name,\n      active: flag(i === monthIdx),\n      onPick: () => this.setState({ monthIdx: i }),\n    }));\n\n    /* Filas: todas las semanas (lunes) que tocan el mes visible. */\n    const first = new Date(M.y, M.m, 1);\n    const start = new Date(M.y, M.m, 1 - monIdx(first));\n    const lastDay = new Date(M.y, M.m + 1, 0);\n    const rows = [];\n    for (let c = new Date(start); c <= lastDay; c.setDate(c.getDate() + 7)) rows.push(new Date(c));\n\n    const dim = filter !== \"all\";\n    const txt = filter === \"wed\" ? deJust : (v) => v;\n    const weekRows = rows.map((mondayDate) => {\n      const wk = weekByMonday[key(mondayDate.getFullYear(), mondayDate.getMonth(), mondayDate.getDate())];\n      const bracket = !!wk;\n      const days = [];\n      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {\n        const dt = new Date(mondayDate);\n        dt.setDate(dt.getDate() + i);\n        const inMonth = dt.getMonth() === M.m;\n        const k = key(dt.getFullYear(), dt.getMonth(), dt.getDate());\n        const r = inMonth ? rev[k] : null;\n        const muted = !!(r && dim && r.kind !== filter);\n        const mk = inMonth && !r ? marks[k] : null;\n        days.push({\n          col: String(i),\n          mark: mk ? mk.type : null,\n          markLabel: mk ? mk.label : \"\",\n          markNote: mk ? (mk.type === \"virtual\" ? \"Avance semanal + análisis de datos\" : mk.note || \"\") : \"\",\n          noteKind: mk && mk.type === \"virtual\" ? \"virtual\" : \"otro\",\n          markCell: mk ? mk.type : null,\n          num: inMonth ? fmt(dt.getDate()) : \"\",\n          weekend: flag(i > 4),\n          out: flag(!inMonth),\n          bracket: flag(bracket && i <= 4),\n          rev: r ? r.kind : null,\n          muted: flag(muted),\n          tag: r ? txt(r.theme) : \"\",\n        });\n      }\n      return { label: wk ? \"Semana \" + wk.n : \"\", bracket, days };\n    });\n\n    /* Lista de semanas del mes visible */\n    const monthWeeks = WEEKS.filter((w) => {\n      const a = new Date(w.mon[0], w.mon[1], w.mon[2]);\n      const b = new Date(w.mon[0], w.mon[1], w.mon[2] + 4);\n      return a.getMonth() === M.m || b.getMonth() === M.m;\n    }).map((w) => {\n      const a = new Date(w.mon[0], w.mon[1], w.mon[2]);\n      const b = new Date(w.mon[0], w.mon[1], w.mon[2] + 4);\n      const sameM = a.getMonth() === b.getMonth();\n      return {\n        label: \"Semana \" + w.n,\n        range: w.rangeLabel ? w.rangeLabel : sameM\n          ? a.getDate() + \" – \" + b.getDate() + \" \" + SHORT[a.getMonth()]\n          : a.getDate() + \" \" + SHORT[a.getMonth()] + \" – \" + b.getDate() + \" \" + SHORT[b.getMonth()],\n        activity: txt(w.activity),\n      };\n    });\n\n    /* Agenda lateral */\n    const shown = REVIEWS.filter((r) => filter === \"all\" || r.kind === filter);\n    const agenda = shown.map((r) => ({\n      kind: r.kind,\n      chip: r.d[2] + \" \" + SHORT[r.d[1]],\n      theme: txt(r.theme),\n      meta: (r.kind === \"mon\" ? \"Lunes · Luis\" : \"Miércoles · Alexia\") + \" · Semana \" + r.week,\n    }));\n\n    return {\n      pageTint: filter,\n      monthName: M.name,\n      monthTabs,\n      weekRows,\n      monthWeeks,\n      agenda,\n      listTitle: filter === \"mon\" ? \"Fechas de Luis\" : filter === \"wed\" ? \"Fechas de Alexia\" : \"Todas las revisiones\",\n      listCount: shown.length + \" fechas\",\n      alexia: { active: flag(filter === \"wed\"), dim: flag(filter === \"mon\"), onClick: () => this.setFilter(\"wed\") },\n      luis: { active: flag(filter === \"mon\"), dim: flag(filter === \"wed\"), onClick: () => this.setFilter(\"mon\") },\n      clearActive: flag(filter === \"all\"),\n      clearFilter: () => this.setState({ filter: \"all\" }),\n    };\n  }\n}\n\n<\u002Fscript>\n\n\n<\u002Fbody><\u002Fhtml>"
  </script>
